title: Command Code
intro: Command Code in headless JSON mode with a bring-your-own provider (DeepSeek's Anthropic-compatible endpoint by default). Text streams token by token; sessions resume by id; effort and a turn cap pass through.

verified.how: not verified: 1.88.0 in headless mode refuses to run without a Command Code account (cmd login), even with a bring-your-own provider and --local-only

notes: providers.json is written every turn with one BYOK provider, hg, whose api follows the provider's shape; --local-only keeps the CLI off its own backend.
--yolo is required in -p mode: --permission-mode yolo alone does not unblock writes.
Only the tool_running event is documented; the other event names come from the 1.88.0 package and may change with a release.
